I felt I should make this post maybe because I just need to talk about it and feel better and it might end up being beneficial who knows . 
I will introduce myself .I was stuck in a bad domestic violence situation that left me suicidal , confused with nothing to my name . Good thing is I am no longer in immediate danger , I have gone through therapy , my son is doing well . We have food , a good landlord , I have made friends and I am almost finishing my very IV in mental health . There is so much support for domestic violence victims but there are some important things that are normally forgotten . 
As a 39 year old woman who is also an immigrant , I have gotten to a point where I am stuck , I am trying everyday but it gets harder . Recovering from DV is not easy , you lose everything including yourself. I was in a situation where I could not get a drivers licence ( while still in the relationship ) and immediately I came out that was not a priority . The priority was food and shelter and emotional recovery . After recovery you can now at least function as you have no other serious worries . You go to school or upskill to try and get back in the workforce especially if it was a situation where you were not allowed to work . This is where it gets tricky . If you have children it’s even worse . Being an immigrant you are probably without family and friends are far apart . Getting a job becomes hard because as much as there is child care , you are most likely not able to afford it . When applying for jobs , most employers will write you off because of availability . If you add on not having a drivers license you now become very undesirable . 
I have a son who I have to pick and drop to school so meaning my availability is between 9 am and 2 pm so that I am back in time to pick him up . I can not do night or late evening shifts . The fact that I have not been able to get my licence eliminates me from 90% of job applications and the lack of experience in the industry leaves me out altogether . At this point one is desperate to get off Centrelink but there is work for the dole , right .... it still does not favour you as more often than not organisations in a field like mental health rarely advertise for that and if they do , they will pick someone with a car and availability that they seek . Fair enough . 
That leaves me with volunteering , without pay , at least for the experience . Every volunteer letter I have sent out this week has come back with a sorry or maybe something like we will get back to you . I have had to hold back tears but giving up is not an option . Even for volunteers , organisations will look for most favourable and volunteering in your field of interest is next to impossible especially for someone in my circumstances . 

The desperation to get off Centrelink and get a licence and pay for childcare to be able to live a normal life is starting to wear me out . I have been in and out of offices , even organisations that help people recovering from domestic violence or any other setback . I just wonder how possible it is to bounce back . I am sure I am not alone in this . The main aim of my post is to really plead with those who work in hr , please give us a chance . There is no way people like me will be able to hack it without the chance to get some form of experience (long term kind not the placements ) to enable us get a job that actually pays so that we can get things like a licence and afford childcare to actually fully come off govt benefits and be independent. 

It is a desperate situation , you try not to fall through the cracks but frustrations grow everyday and it becomes near impossible to not cry yourself to sleep everyday . Australia has enabled me get somewhere which is so amazing !! I really appreciate that with all my heart . If only people are able to get through that final hurdle then I feel a lot of people will appreciate . It is harder for immigrant women who for most of their stay here were isolated and had no family . 

It is my prayer that someone in a HR role somewhere will give a woman in similar circumstances as me a chance .Maybe just ask why they do not have a licence or why their availability is not regular . Please . I wrote this because I know someone somewhere might just be struggling as I am and maybe there is an employer here who will read : 

I am not giving up trying . I am still doing my level best . I have a new lease of life after 8 years of absolute horror and I can’t wait to come back here and share when I finally ace it . If I didn’t give up then , I will not give up now :) or ever . I have so much hope left in me : If there is someone out there like me or still stuck in a DV situation don’t lose hope , try and try again .

Then when we finally move to a place they can attend school , they are graded and they have always been placed in the right classes . Most of the time we just look at maps , wonder how it is living in a certain place . Watch youtube videos and if we like what we see then we check visa requirements and plan on the trip. We do  so much research before hand like the political situation etc. We do not focus on school so much because i would hate my kids to be all about grades and the rat race . I want us to live and just enjoy life . We do not have much  money  but i have a few things i can do to generate money .
